Abstract: An efficient approach for the synthesis of
1,2,3,4,5,6-hexahydrobenzo[f]isoquinolines via a
tandem aza-Prins/Friedel–Crafts cyclization from 2-
arylethyl-2,3-butadienyl tosylamides anda ldehydes
has been developed. This iron(III) chloride-catalyzed
cascade cyclization at the room temperature with dif-
ferent types of aldehydes,s uch as aromatica nd het-
eroaromatic aldehydes, alkyla ldehydes,a nd a,b-un-
saturateda ldehydes,a ffords the productsi nm oder-
ate to excellent yields (up to 97 %). In this reaction,
chlorotrimethylsilane wasa pplied to activate the al-
dehydes.T he cheap catalyst, the mild reactionc ondi-
tions,a nd the broad scope of the substratesm ake
this method highly useful.
Keywords: allene;a za-Prins cyclization;b enzo[f]iso-
quinoline;c ascade;i ron(III) chloride
Introduction
Benzo[f]isoquinoline alkaloids are ac lass of impor-
tant heterocycles with interesting pharmacological ac-
tivities,[1, 2] such as high-affinity s ligands serving as
potentially therapeutic agents for the treatment of
Parkinson(o[vsdisease and schizophrenia[1b–f] and poten-
tial calcium channel blockers.[2] Thus,m uch attention
has been paid to the synthesis of this class of com-
pounds.[1e,3 –7] Prins cyclization using alkenesa nd al-
kynesh as became ap owerful synthetic method for
the synthesis of heterocyclic compounds.[8, 9] However,
Prins cyclization utilizing allenes is still not well ex-
plored for the issue of regioselectivity.[10] In 2012, we
reported that 2,3-butadienyl tosylamides with alde-
hydesp roduced2 ,5-dihydro-1H-pyrrole or 1,2,3,6-tet-
rahydropyridine derivatives respectively,d epending
on the nature of the R1 substituent. (Scheme 1, eq.
1).[10c] We envisioned that when an aryl group is teth-
ered into the R1 substituentw ith two carbon atom
chain,2 -arylethyl-2,3-butadienyl tosylamides would
react with aldehydest op rovide iminiums Int-
1 (Scheme 1, eq.2 ). We wondered whethers equential
Friedel–Crafts type cyclizations would provide tricy-
clic products 5 or 6 either via Int-2 or Int-3 or ac on-
certed process.H erein, we report our recent observa-
tions on this topic.

Results and Discussion
We began our study with 2-(2-phenylethyl)-2,3-buta-
dienyl tosylamide 3a ,w hich could be easily obtained
based on ak nown method,d eveloped by us,[11] and p-
chlorobenzaldehyde 4a .T oo ur delight, under the cat-
alysis of FeCl3 (20 mol %) in CH2Cl2 with stirring at
room temperature for 52 h, one of the two expected
products, hexahydrobenzo[f]isoquinoline 5a ,w as ob-
tained in 43 %y ield (Table 1, entry 1).[12] Thes truc-
ture of this product was confirmed by its X-ray crys-
tallographic study( Figure 1).[13] Thef ormation of 6a
via Int-3-type intermediate was not observed.
Increasing the amount of the catalyst did not im-
prove the yield significantly (Table 1, entries 2–3).
Thed esired product 5a was not formed under other
metal catalysts such as In(OTf)3,S c(OTf)3,C u(OTf)2,
and Cu(acac)2 (Table 1, entries 4–7). They ield of the
product 5a improved greatly to 83 %b y the addition
of 2.5e quiv of TMSCl( Table 1, entry 8), which may
activate the carbonyl group.[12b,1 4] Furthermore,w hen
the amount of TMSCl was reducedt o1 .5 equiv,t he
product 5a was obtained in 89 %. This was found to
be the optimum amount of this additive( Table1 ,e n-
tries 9–12). In addition,t he yield of the reactiond rop-
ped when the amount of 3a was reduced (Table 1, en-
tries 13–14). Thus, 3a (1.5 equiv), 4a (1.0 equiv),
FeCl3 (20 mol %), and TMSCl( 1.5 equiv) in CH2Cl2
at room temperature were defined as the optimized
reactionc onditions for further study.
To examine the scope of the cascade aza-Prins/Frie-
del–Crafts cyclization, diversifieda ldehydesw ere ex-
amined for their reactionw ith 3a under the optimal
reactionc onditions.I na ddition to the p-chlorobenzal-
dehyde 4a ,b enzaldehydew ith different substituents,
such as electron-donating p-MeO and electronic-with-
drawing p-F, p-Br, p-I, as well as o-Clg roups,c ould
all afford the desired products 5 in good to excellent
yields (Table 2, entries1 –6). 2-Naphthaldehydea lso
reacted smoothly to afford the desired product 5h in
an excellent yield (Table 2, entry 7). Thes cope of this
reactionm ay also be extended to heteroaromatic al-
dehydes,s uch as 3-thiophenaldehyde,3 -furaldehyde
and N-Ts-indole-3-carboxaldehyde (Table 2, entries 8–
10). Cyclic and aliphatic aldehydes with Cl or phenyl
substituents,a nd event he paraformaldehyde afforded
the desired products 5l –5o successfully (Table 2, en-
tries 11–14).
Excitingly, a,b-unsaturated alk-2-ynals,s uch as 2-
nonynal 4p and2 -propynal 4q also affordedt he cor-
responding products( Scheme 2). These types of func-
tionalized productsp rovide opportunitiesf or further
synthetic elaboration.

Conclusions
In conclusion, we have developed an efficient meth-
odology for the synthesiso f1 ,2,3,4,5,6-hexahydroben-
zo[f]isoquinolines via novel FeCl3 catalysed aza-Prins-
intramolecular Friedel–Crafts cascade cyclization
from readily available 2-arylethyl-2,3-butadienyl tosy-
lamidesa nd different types of aldehydes.T he mild re-
action conditions (rt), the cheap catalyst (FeCl3), the
broad scope of the substrates with the potential ma-
nipulation of the installed functionality,a nd the effi-
ciency to the pharmacologically important benzo[f]i-
soquinolines skeletons make this method highly inter-
esting to the organic chemists and pharmacologists.
